name: Deploy LMS App

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: SSH into server and deploy
        uses: appleboy/ssh-action@v1.0.3
        with:
          host: ${{ secrets.EC2_HOST }}
          username: ubuntu
          key: ${{ secrets.EC2_SSH_KEY }}
          script: |
            cd lms
            git pull origin main
            sudo docker stop lms-container || true
            sudo docker rm lms-container || true
            sudo docker build -t lms-app .
            sudo docker run -d -p 8080:8080 --name lms-container lms-app java -Xmx400m -jar app.jar
